title: Condensed configurations and valuative matroid invariants
summary: Condensed configurations are compact incidence data obtained by grouping the cyclic flats of a matroid. We show that their inverse incidence matrices give explicit Schubert expansions and hence determine every valuative or covaluative matroid invariant. For the extended binary Golay matroid, this unexpectedly produces non-real-rooted Kazhdan-Lusztig and Z-polynomials. To our knowledge, the latter is the first counterexample in the literature.
